name: fable_session
description:
Fable Cognitive Engine Session & Telemetry Manager for MCP-compatible agent hosts.
Enforces immutable authority time-locks, evidence-gated epistemic tracking, formal invariant modeling, continuous rethink-refine cycles, phased progression, subagent delegation contract compilation, internal pacing telemetry, token compression subsystem (Content-Addressed Storage, 0.003 tokens/character invariant), and System 3 Meta-Cognitive Deliberation & Dialectical Evolutionary Architecture (Pearl do-calculus, TRIZ contradiction synthesis, 10D Pareto genetic search, axiom induction, Poincaré hyperbolic embeddings, Kripke modal model checking, Friston active inference, and Gödelian constructive proof oracle).

a_matrix.description: Observation likelihood matrix A [O x S] for Active Inference.

actions.description: List of control action identifiers for Active Inference POMDP.

action.description: The Fable session action to perform.

accumulate_payload.description: Micro-payload text for adaptive batch accumulator or CAS storage.

axioms.description: List of reference axiom names or strings for proof oracle.

edges.description: List of directed edge dictionaries for Causal DAG construction.

epistemic_uncertainty.description: Epistemic uncertainty index [0.0, 1.0] for System 3 arbitration.
